ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee data, trade records and other information relating to Licensee or its customers that is held in or generated through the Licensed Technology, in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit as Article XXI(c): our data comes back in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, with up to six months' transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates and deletion plus written certification only after return. Article XXI currently obliges only us to return materials and is silent on our own data; a 90-day assistance period with the same 30-day export is our fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data-return obligation as Article XXI(c) (Effect of Termination).
